description: Gets ticket prices (Gran Cine does not publish them). Cinepic requires cinema_id, movie_id and session_id from get_showtimes. Cines Unidos requires cinema_id, session_id and a connected account. Cinex requires cinema_id, session_id and a connected account. Supercines requires cinema_id, movie_id and session_id, and date if the showtime is not today; it does not require an account (if the user connected theirs, prices are read with it). Returns USD/VES when verifiable, Cinex breakdown in VES. Does not return final purchase totals.

cinema_id.description: Venue ID returned by list_cinemas for the same provider. Do not mix IDs across providers. If the venue includes code_status, use cinema_id only when it is verified; directory-* IDs cannot be queried.

date.description: Supercines only: showtime date (YYYY-MM-DD), the same one used in get_showtimes; defaults to today in America/Caracas. Its prices vary by day.

movie_id.description: Movie ID returned by list_movies for the same provider; optional for Cinex when querying a whole venue.

provider.description: Cinema provider; get its capabilities and limitations with list_providers.

refresh.description: true: queries the provider without the local cache and requests HTTP revalidation. Does not guarantee that the provider has updated its content.

session_id.description: Showtime ID returned by get_showtimes for the same provider.

name: get_ticket_prices

language.description: Version: es or en (dubbed) and subtitulada at Cinex and Cines Unidos (which also marks it in the title, (Esp) or (Sub)); subtitulada or no_subtitulada at Cinepic. Absent when not confirmed.

prices.description: Verifiable amounts from the provider; [] means there was no usable amount.

screen.description: Room as the provider names it (3, VIP, VIP (Piso 5), 4DX).

tickets_available.description: Tickets the provider's website still offers online with this fare (Cinepic: its quota minus tickets sold and held in purchases in progress). It can be lower than the free seats.

title: Get ticket prices
